evidence.title: San Telmo Walking Tour and Market Experience – Buenos Aires
evidence.snippet: Experience the heart of Buenos Aires with a walking tour through San Telmo, the city's oldest neighborhood. Explore cobblestone streets lined with 19th-century architecture and uncover stories of colonial history and Argentine heritage. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere as you learn how immigration shaped local culture and see the neighborhood come alive with music and art during the famous Sunday street fair. - Visit the iconic San Telmo Food Market and discover its rich history and unique features.…
